grammar_restrictions: one entry; headers in version/target/address_size order
register declarations precede instructions; no nested scopes
whole scalar ld.param only; optional explicit offset zero
predicated ld.param and ret rejected; unconditional ret must be last
decimal/hex/octal/binary 64-bit integer literals, optional U and unary sign; no expressions
source up to 1 MiB, total registers up to 4096, instructions up to 65536
special registers only as mov.u32 source
conservative initializedness under identical versioned predicate or both polarities
global pointer provenance from u64 parameters through mov/cvta and pointer+integer add
all active memory accesses must be aligned and within live allocations; no memory sandbox
